## Skill Name
Which skill? `cm-<name>`

## Current Problem
What is wrong or sub-optimal? Be specific.
- [ ] Too broad / monolithic (SkillsBench: monolithic skills = -2.9pp)
- [ ] Unclear steps
- [ ] Missing edge cases
- [ ] Poor composability in chains
- [ ] Other: ___

## Current Quality Score (estimate)
Rate the skill on SkillsBench rubric (0–3 each):
- Task specificity: __/3
- Procedural clarity: __/3
- Edge case coverage: __/3
- Composability: __/3
- **Total: __/12** (target: ≥9)

## Proposed Improvement
Describe the change. If splitting into sub-skills, name them.

## Expected Impact
What improvement do you expect? (e.g. "+2pp on TDD regression benchmark")
